exposure: maternal physical activity level before pregnancy (very sporty, moderately sporty, inactive)
degree of involvement of perineal muscles during physical activity
continuation/discontinuation of physical activity during pregnancy
cohort: The study included all consecutive women who delivered at the Del Ponte Hospital between July and September 2014.
finding: Perineal outcomes are not influenced by the overall intensity of sport activity, but continuous sports during pregnancy that specifically train the perineal muscles are associated with a lower rate of episiotomy and severe perineal lacerations.
